statements.status_notes: The keystore-go Decode integrity-check bypass is absent from cass-operator's shipped manager binaries. Cass-operator generates JKS stores with keystore.Encode from a PEM CA certificate and private key; it does not decode JKS input. The runtime, dev, FIPS and FIPS-dev manager binaries on amd64 and arm64 retain EncodeWithRand and encoder helpers but contain neither Decode nor its decoder helpers. Source: https://github.com/k8ssandra/cass-operator/blob/c18a5d5e78ca672633dce1493426929c3396b24e/pkg/utils/crypto.go#L85-L139 . Advisory: https://github.com/pavlo-v-chernykh/keystore-go/security/advisories/GHSA-j282-pjg5-j643 .
